biggest_catch: You need recurring qualifying direct deposits of at least $500 per month maintained through a full 90-day qualification period, and the $400 only pays out after that 90-day period ends — no early payout, and early closure may trigger fees.
catches: Qualifying direct deposit means a recurring electronic credit of salary, pension, Social Security, or other regular monthly income from an employer or outside agency; account-to-account transfers and ATM deposits do NOT qualify.
You must receive qualifying recurring direct deposits of at least $500 per month within 90 days of opening and maintain them throughout the 90-day Qualification Period.
Only for new and existing members age 13+ WITHOUT a checking account; the account owner may not have closed an APGFCU checking account on or after September 1, 2025.
Offer cannot be combined with any other offers; does not apply to second or multiple checking accounts; limit one bonus per member.
The checking account must remain open for a minimum of 90 days and all membership accounts must be in good standing to receive the bonus; fees may apply for early closure of the checking account.
Offer expires November 30, 2026, and may be extended, modified, or discontinued at any time without prior notice.
Any applicable taxes are the responsibility of the recipient — the bonus is taxable income.

steps: Open a new High Yield Checking, Member Protect Checking, or Standard Checking account with APGFCU between September 1, 2026 and November 30, 2026 (membership eligibility applies).

Within 90 days of opening, set up recurring qualifying direct deposits (salary, pension, Social Security, or other regular monthly income from an employer/outside agency) of at least $500 per month into the checking account.
Maintain the qualifying recurring direct deposits throughout the 90-day Qualification Period and keep the account open and in good standing for the full 90 days.
The $400 bonus is credited to your checking account on the first business day following the end of the 90-day Qualification Period.
timing: The bonus will be credited to your checking account on the first business day following the end of the 90-day Qualification Period. The checking account must remain open for a minimum of 90 days to receive the bonus.
